obj = bpy.data.objects.get("node_0")
info = {}
if obj and obj.type == 'MESH':
    mesh = obj.data
    info["vertices"] = len(mesh.vertices)
    info["polygons"] = len(mesh.polygons)
    info["materials"] = [m.name for m in obj.material_slots if m.material]
    info["vertex_groups"] = [vg.name for vg in obj.vertex_groups]
    info["modifiers"] = [{m.name: m.type} for m in obj.modifiers]

import bpy

obj = bpy.data.objects.get("node_0")
mesh = obj.data

# Check shade smooth per face
smooth_faces = sum(1 for p in mesh.polygons if p.use_smooth)
flat_faces = len(mesh.polygons) - smooth_faces

# Check bounds of weapon arm vertices
vg = obj.vertex_groups.get("Weapons_Arm")
vg_idx = vg.index if vg else None
weapon_coords = []
if vg_idx is not None:
    for v in mesh.vertices:
        for g in v.groups:
            if g.group == vg_idx and g.weight > 0.5:
                weapon_coords.append(v.co)
                break

min_c = [min(c[i] for c in weapon_coords) for i in range(3)] if weapon_coords else None
max_c = [max(c[i] for c in weapon_coords) for i in range(3)] if weapon_coords else None

result = {
    "total_polys": len(mesh.polygons),
    "smooth_faces": smooth_faces,
    "flat_faces": flat_faces,
    "weapon_bounds_min": min_c,
    "weapon_bounds_max": max_c
}

import bpy
import bmesh

obj = bpy.data.objects.get("node_0")
mesh = obj.data

# Check if there are disconnected mesh islands (loose parts)
bm = bmesh.new()
bm.from_mesh(mesh)

# Tag connected components
visited = set()
islands = []
for v in bm.verts:
    if v.index in visited:
        continue
    island_verts = []
    queue = [v]
    visited.add(v.index)
    while queue:
        curr = queue.pop()
        island_verts.append(curr.index)
        for edge in curr.link_edges:
            other = edge.other_vert(curr)
            if other.index not in visited:
                visited.add(other.index)
                queue.append(other)
    islands.append({
        "vert_count": len(island_verts),
        "first_vert": island_verts[0]
    })
    if len(islands) > 50:
        break

bm.free()

islands.sort(key=lambda x: x["vert_count"], reverse=True)

result = {
    "num_islands_found": len(islands),
    "largest_islands": islands[:10]
}

import bpy

# Set up a camera pointing at the weapon arm and render viewport or thumbnail
cam = bpy.data.objects.get("Camera")
if not cam:
    cam_data = bpy.data.cameras.new("Cam")
    cam = bpy.data.objects.new("Camera", cam_data)
    bpy.context.scene.collection.objects.link(cam)

bpy.context.scene.camera = cam

# Position camera towards arm/weapon
# Bounds: x: [0.2, 0.45], y: [0.55, 0.85], z: [-0.1, 0.1]
# Let's check which arm has the weapon, or both
vg = bpy.data.objects["node_0"].vertex_groups.get("Weapons_Arm")
vg_idx = vg.index
left_coords = []
right_coords = []
for v in bpy.data.objects["node_0"].data.vertices:
    for g in v.groups:
        if g.group == vg_idx:
            if v.co.x > 0:
                right_coords.append(v.co)
            else:
                left_coords.append(v.co)
            break

result = {
    "left_coords_count": len(left_coords),

}

# Check if there are non-manifold geometry, loose geometry, bad normals

non_manifold_verts = sum(1 for v in bm.verts if not v.is_manifold)
non_manifold_edges = sum(1 for e in bm.edges if not e.is_manifold)
boundary_edges = sum(1 for e in bm.edges if e.is_boundary)

# Check custom split normals layer

# In modern Blender (4.1+), auto smooth is modifier / sharp edges or attributes
attributes = [a.name for a in mesh.attributes]

bm.free()

result = {
    "non_manifold_verts": non_manifold_verts,
    "non_manifold_edges": non_manifold_edges,
    "boundary_edges": boundary_edges,
    "wire_edges": wire_edges,
    "attributes": attributes,

}
